worldcombat.skill.rollout.summary: Curl into a stone ball and roll into the target again and again: the ball carries inertia and can only turn toward your aim slowly; every real landed pass makes the next one heavier (up to 5 passes), and a hit knocks the target away, so you have to close in to keep going. A wall, a graze or any other move wipes the chain.
worldcombat.skill.rollout.description.0: The ball rolls tick by tick and truly runs into the first enemy, hitting for about %1$s contact damage; the chain runs up to %2$s passes, then spends itself and the level resets.
worldcombat.skill.rollout.description.1: When the ball truly reaches a foe it hits for %1$s; it rolls up to %2$s blocks with a %3$s-block hitbox, and a landed hit knocks the target %4$s blocks away.
worldcombat.skill.rollout.description.2: It bounces back %1$s blocks from the real point of contact; roll the same move again within %2$s to keep the chain and make the next pass heavier. A wall, a graze, or committing to any other move wipes the chain at once.
worldcombat.skill.rollout.heavy.on: Heavy ball: each landed pass multiplies the next by 2.35 and the chain window runs 8 ticks longer; costs 5% hit chance per pass, 0.92x rolling reach, 0.6x turning per tick, +1 tick preparation, +2 ticks recovery and +8 ticks cooldown - a heavier roll, though harder to keep going and much harder to turn.
worldcombat.skill.rollout.heavy.off: Light ball (the native form): 2x per pass, 2% more hit chance, a longer rolling reach, sharper turning, a shorter recovery and 4 ticks less cooldown; at a lower per-pass power ceiling - a smoother and cheaper roll.
worldcombat.skill.rollout.timing: Range %1$s blocks; %2$s s preparation, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.rollout.growth.0: From level %1$s each pass rises to %2$s and the chain window extends to %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.rollout.growth.1: From level %1$s each pass rises to %2$s and the rolling reach extends to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.rollout.use.0: Roll into the target one pass after another
worldcombat.skill.rollout.use.1: Double the next pass on every real landed hit
worldcombat.skill.rollout.use.2: The ball carries inertia and turns slowly; a wall or a miss shatters the chain
worldcombat.skill.rollout.preference.hea: On (heavy): each landed pass multiplies by 2.35 (a higher ceiling), at -5% hit chance per pass, a shorter rolling reach, 0.6x turning per tick, +2 ticks recovery and +8 ticks cooldown. Off (light, the native form): 2x per pass, +2% hit chance, a longer and smoother roll with sharper turning, shorter recovery and cooldown, at a lower ceiling.
Beyond this distance it closes in instead of rolling. Larger values open the chain from further out.
On: while it carries the roll chain it prefers to keep rolling and extend the string. Off: it ranks the move as an ordinary mid-range tackle either way.
world_combat.move.rollout.text.miss: Rollout whiffed; the chain is gone
world_combat.move.rollout.text.cap: Rollout ran its %1$s passes and spent itself
